text: the ETA (https://israel-entry.piba.gov.il/)  is needed for every tourist, that can enter visa free to israel. in general if parents of b1/a5-visa holders come, there is a suspicion of border control that they might stay illegally, so an invitation can be more helpful. you can do it according to this process: https://www.gov.il/en/service/request_for_tourist_visa_b2
